description: Generated registry members with no reader yet (scripts/registry-readers.mjs, run by gen-registries --check). Each entry names why and the issue that removes it. An entry that gains a reader fails the check, so this list only shrinks. Wildcard entries (`Object.*`) are frozen to dynamic-lookup catalogs (icons, capabilities, task-page blocks, platform IDs, and settings.json-driven option enums) — never add a new wildcard for settings, prompts, notices, actions, surfaces, or entity fields. The `ships` lane, keyed `<platform>:<featureId>`, excuses a capabilities.json ships or partial claim on Apple, Android, or Web whose registry entries no source on that platform reads (#285).
